Alex Morgan: Quick follow-up from the 01:30UTC postmortem. We had repeated KV write stalls during ingestion bursts; we need tracked action items, SLO decisions, and recurrence automation.

Priya Nair: Summary numbers? How much did p95/p99 move and what's the error-budget impact?

Alex Morgan: p95 from 130ms->340ms, p99 from 210ms->780ms during a ~9m window. Rough error-budget burn: ~1.6% daily on p99 SLO (target p99<300ms monthly). Recurrence: 4 incidents in last 90d.

Samir Patel: Ops or infra? where's the pressure?

Alex Morgan: Infra: KV write queueing + large feeder batches. Model exec unaffected. I've attached decomposition to the SRE dashboard: https://redwood/dashboards/incident/1769998888-decomp (view).

Jules (ops): Ops preference: avoid customer throttles. Suggest temporary SLO concession + quick ingress smoothing and auto-revert. Also propose governance rule: any service-level concession >24h needs exec signoff.

Priya Nair: Sounds reasonable. If we do a 72h concession for p99 -> 420ms, what's the projected monthly burn?

Alex Morgan: Back-of-envelope: a 72h bump to 420ms buys ~2.2% of daily buffer but keeps monthly burn <3.5% assuming no further events. It's safer than throttling.

Samir Patel: I'll own the ingress smoothing PR. Plan: reduce feeder burst cap 2k->900, add randomized jitter, canary 5%/25%/100%. ETA 18h.

Priya Nair: I'll own observability + alerting. Proposed PromQL for p99-by-prefix: 
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(cache_request_latency_bucket{route=~"/cache/.*"}[5m])) by (le, prefix))
```
Alert: warn at >300ms(5m), page >420ms(10m). Also add p95 and throughput tiles by prefix. ETA 48h.

Nina Rao: I'll coordinate SLO policy updates and SLA note. Draft wording: "Temporary p99 concession to 420ms for 72 hours due to ingestion-induced KV write contention. Auto-revert scheduled; customers notified if concession extends >24h." Owner: Nina (ops), immediate.

Alex Morgan: Action items (owners + ETA): 1) Temporary SLO concession p99->420ms for 72h (owner Nina, immediate) 2) Ingress smoothing feeder caps + jitter (owner Samir, 18h) 3) KV driver investigation and fsync coalescer (owner Priya & infra, 5d) 4) Observability: p99-by-prefix, synthetic probe 30s cadence (owner Priya, 48h) 5) Runbook update: automatic fallback to best-effort pool for non-critical routes (owner Alex, 7d) 6) Recurrence automation: watch that opens INF-6001 if >=2 events in 30d (owner Alex, 7d).

monitor-bot: Created ticket INF-6001 "recurrence-watch: ingestion-kv-write-stalls" and linked this thread.

Samir Patel: I'll open PR and include perf comparisons and rollback steps. Will add a canary probe in the PR. PR ETA 18h.

Priya Nair: For the synthetic probe: small write, read-back, measure write-latency and write-size. Probe should expose write-amplification metric. I'll push the probe as a k8s CronJob in canary namespace. ETA 36h.

Nina Rao: Governance addition: track concessions in a central ledger and require a 7d postmortem link for any concession taken. If a service has >=3 concessions in 90d, auto-escalate to Platform Review committee. I'll add to policy doc and attach to the ticket.

Alex Morgan: Also propose automated mitigation: if recurrence-watch detects 2 events in 30d, trigger a temporary ingress cap and notify owners. That buys time for root-cause patch. Owner Alex, implement INF-6001.

Samir Patel: PR opened: https://git.redwood/feeder/pull/1102 (canary steps + perf).

Priya Nair: Dashboard tiles added to the SRE workspace and probe manifest in a draft PR: https://git.redwood/observability/pull/442.

Nina Rao: Applied the SLO concession and updated SLA note. Auto-revert set for 72h. Logged INF-6002 "SLO concession log entry".

Alex Morgan: Recap owners and ETAs: Nina (SLO concession + governance, immediate), Samir (ingest smoothing PR, 18h), Priya (observability + probe, 36-48h), Alex (runbook + recurrence INF-6001, 7d), infra (driver patch, 5d). 15m sync tomorrow at 14:30 UTC to confirm PRs/tickets linked. Will close thread after PRs referenced.

Samir Patel: :thumbsup:

Priya Nair: Noted.

Nina Rao: Posting a short announcement to #announcements after PRs link.

Alex Morgan: Thanks all. Leaving this thread open for updates; closing once INF-6001/6002 and PRs are closed.
